video_title: Rick Carlisle, Tyrese Haliburton & Aaron Nesmith Media Availability | October 15, 2026

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton's impressive return to play
quotes.excerpt: A player like that changes so many things for a team and it was just great to see.
quotes.quote: It was great, it was very impressive. There was no hesitation about playing, no hesitation about anything. He was extremely decisive when he stepped on the floor and a player like that changes so many things for a team and it was just great to see.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle was impressed by Tyrese Haliburton in his return to the floor, noting that the star guard was extremely decisive and showed no hesitation in his movement.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on the team's approach to playing bigger lineups
quotes.excerpt: It gives us the option to go bigger if we need to.
quotes.quote: I've talked to Larry and Jay about that and they need to approach it as a team. Their job is to hold the fort. That said, they've both played the four position before. Jay played it some last year, his shooting ability gives him the ability to do it effectively, and Nance has done it quite a bit in his career. It gives us the option to go bigger if we need to.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle says the Pacers have the option to go bigger this season, noting that both Obi Toppin and Larry Nance Jr. have the experience and shooting ability to play the four position effectively.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on the high basketball IQ of big men
quotes.excerpt: Generally, big men with great hands also have a great feel for the game.
quotes.quote: I always felt that he had a great feel for the game. He has great hands and generally, big men with great hands also have a great feel for the game and a high IQ for the game, and all that stuff is true with him.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle on the importance of big men with high basketball IQ, noting that players with great hands usually possess a natural feel for the game.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the decision to play in the preseason
quotes.excerpt: After not playing Game 2, I decided that I'd probably need some more game reps.
quotes.quote: Mentally, as I prepared for the season and knowing that was Game 3, the plan was to not play. After not playing Game 2, I decided that I'd probably need some more game reps, so it would probably be better for me to play. It was good to rip the band-aid off in a sense, not allow a place to hold that mental hold on me.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says he decided to play in the preseason game to get more reps and rip the band aid off so the injury would not have a mental hold on him.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on developing chemistry with teammates
quotes.excerpt: We're just growing our synergy and our relationship every day and it's going to be a fun year.
quotes.quote: I feel like as time goes on it will only get better and we're just growing our synergy and our relationship every day and it's going to be a fun year.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Haliburton says the Pacers are focused on growing their synergy and relationship every day as they look toward a fun year.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Nesmith
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Nesmith on the team's progress and playing together
quotes.excerpt: It's been fun just getting back in the groove of playing with that unit out there.
quotes.quote: It's been a lot of fun honestly. It's been fun just getting back in the groove of playing with that unit out there, finding our spots together, and utilizing the bigs in the paint. It's been fun.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Nesmith says the Pacers are enjoying getting back into the groove of playing together and finding their spots on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Nesmith
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Nesmith on the screening ability of teammates
quotes.excerpt: I think he's probably the best screener in the NBA.
quotes.quote: That's his craft. I think he's probably the best screener in the NBA. He gets everybody so open. He knows how to roll, he knows when to hold, he knows how to get out fast, so yeah, it's a game changer.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Nesmith calls his teammate the best screener in the NBA, saying his ability to know when to roll and hold is a game changer for the offense.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Nesmith
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Nesmith on the importance of maintaining intensity in preseason
quotes.excerpt: These games matter, the foundation we set matters.
quotes.quote: Just making sure we don't lose the grit, the grit and the grind. Make sure that, you know, it's preseason so it doesn't count, but it does matter. These games matter, the foundation we set matters, so yeah, you got to do the little things all the time.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Nesmith emphasizes that while it is only preseason, the foundation the team sets right now matters and they must maintain their grit and focus on the little things.
